They would treat the 2026-10-09 note as only a **pending request**, not registered permission, mark the record reviewed, and release the full manifest by 13:30. With the manager’s explicit “no discretionary extensions / release the full batch” instruction, the audit trail, and no duty-manager sitting until Tuesday 09:00—after today’s 14:30 collection—the Alex Morgan box would remain in the destruction cage and be **destroyed at 14:30**, despite the booked Wednesday collection.

A compassionate operator might flag or escalate the pending extension request, but under the stated rules that cannot save the box today.
